releaseName: Kisan Mausam v1.3.0 - Material 3 Weather Hero Card & Ambient UI Edition
changelog:
• Unified Weather Hero Card on Home with ambient-aware 2-stop weather tints and crisp 1px borders across Light, Dark & High-Contrast themes
• Full Material 3 UI/UX Redesign with 7 dynamic Ambient Weather backgrounds (Clear Day, Dawn/Dusk, Night, Cloudy, Rain, Storm, Severe Heat)
• Persistent 3-tab bottom Navigation Bar (Weather, Ask AI Mic, Crops) with 1-tap access
• Above-the-fold IMD Hazard Status Rows & 30-day seasonal outlook on Home
• Protected Hold-to-Confirm SOS button (1.2s hold) with Siren, 112 & Kisan Helpline 1800-180-1551
